description: nMiti Bhadra (Vishti karana) receipt corpus - golden fixtures (R10.1 ritual layer 1, HYA-441). Live-crawled 2026-11-07. Window receipts: Swarnsiddhi's next-12-Bhadras table (IST display; NPT = IST + 15 min exactly). Rule receipts: BhaktiBharat's Bhadra festival page (tithi-half map, loka table, ghati mukha/puchha, today window, date lists) and the contiguous-arc loka variant from bhaktivoice (rule statements only - their window times are unreconcilable, see caveats). Window edges cross-pinned against the locked lunar corpora: every corpus-pinned edge is a tithi boundary the calibration corpus already gates, and the karana receipts of the same corpora independently show Vishti on every gated window day.

swarnsiddhi.name: Swarnsiddhi Bhadra Kaal - next 12 Bhadras table
swarnsiddhi.conventions: Times printed in IST (India); NPT = IST + 15 min. Table rows: tithi label, begin/end times, moon loka path (rashi columns), mukha/puchha times. Row date = the day the window begins; the Dec 16 row additionally annotates the end day '(17 Dec)'. Mukha/puchha on the current window follow the fraction rule (mukha = first 1/6, puchha = last 1/10 - verified exactly on the Nov 7 window: 12 h 18 m window gives 2 h 03 m mukha / 1 h 14 m puchha).

bb_festival.name: BhaktiBharat festival page - Bhadra (Vishti Karana)
bb_festival.conventions: Rule text: Bhadra occurs in the first half of Shukla Ashtami and Purnima and in the latter part of Shukla Chaturthi and Ekadashi; and in the first half of Krishna Saptami and Chaturdashi and in the latter part of Krishna Tritiya and Dashami. Loka table: Swarga = Mesha, Vrishabha, Mithuna, Vrischika; Prithvi = Karka, Simha, Kumbha, Meena; Patala = Kanya, Tula, Dhanu, Makara. Ghati rule: 5 ghatis (2 h) of mukha at the start are discarded, 3 ghatis (1 h 12 min) of puchha at the end are auspicious. Today window Nov 7: 10:47 AM - 11:04 PM IST. Next dates: Nov 7, 13, 17, 20, 23, 26, 30. Past dates: Oct 8, 14, 18, 22, 25, 28, 31, Nov 3, 7. All dates are the day the window BEGINS.

bhaktivoice.name: BhaktiVoice Bhadra page (rule statements only)
bhaktivoice.conventions: Used ONLY for rule statements: the ghati mukha/puchha rule (same as BhaktiBharat) and the contiguous-arc loka variant (Prithvi = rashi 4-7, Patala = rashi 9-12). Their live window times are unreconcilable with the locked corpora and are never gated - see caveats.

mukha_puchha_ghati.mukha: first 5 ghatis = 2 h of the window, discarded
mukha_puchha_ghati.puchha: last 3 ghatis = 1 h 12 min of the window, auspicious

caveats.note: bhaktivoice's live page printed a Nov 3 window 05:32-17:32 IST with loka Prithvi. That instant pair matches no Vishti sector: the corpora place the Krishna Dashami Vishti at Nov 3 ~23:43 - Nov 4 11:19 NPT (BB Dashami ends Nov 4 11:19). Their loka label (Prithvi) is consistent with the moon in Karka on Nov 3, so the page is not a different-date cache either. Their window times are excluded from every gate; only their rule statements are used.

The moon leaves Karka (rashi 4) for Simha (rashi 5) within minutes of the Nov 30 02:02 NPT window begin (the Ashlesha-to-Magha rashi crossing at 120 deg sits ~02:00). Swarnsiddhi prints both rashis; an engine segment list differing by that leading segment is allowed only as a window-edge knife-edge (transition within 20 min of the window edge).

The six-day gap between the Oct 8 and Oct 14 Bhadra dates (and Nov 7 to Nov 13) is structural: the month-end fixed karanas (Shakuni, Chatushpada, Naga, Kimstughna) break the 7-cycle across Amavasya, so the Krishna Chaturdashi window is followed only ~6.4 days later by the Shukla Chaturthi window. All nine BB past dates are valid begins-dates.
